title: Values of the podiumd-admin chart
description: The application settings live under `settings`, which is strict. The other values are common Kubernetes configuration with PodiumD's names; keys the chart does not define are allowed outside `settings` (issue #38, design D8).

global.description: Values shared with a parent chart when this chart is a subchart (ADR 0006).

imageRegistry.description: A registry that replaces image.registry, e.g. a mirror.

nameOverride.description: Overrides the chart name in resource names.

registry.description: The image registry; global.imageRegistry replaces it when set.

repository.description: The image repository within the registry.

tag.description: The image tag, optionally with a digest (<tag>@sha256:<digest>); empty uses the chart's appVersion.

imagePullSecrets.description: Secrets for pulling the image, as Kubernetes LocalObjectReference entries.

replicaCount.description: The number of Admin Tool pods: 1, or 0 to stop it. Never more than one (ADR 0010).

settings.description: The application settings: each PODIUMD_ADMIN_* environment variable of the Admin Tool (backend/src/podiumd_admin/config.py), named and typed. Strict: an unknown key fails, and secrets are only references to existing Secrets (issue #38).

environment.description: The Environment this Admin Tool Instance belongs to (design D5).

stage.description: Required. The stage of the Environment. (PODIUMD_ADMIN_ENVIRONMENT_STAGE)

label.description: An optional label shown next to the Municipality and stage. (PODIUMD_ADMIN_ENVIRONMENT_LABEL)

publicHostname.description: Required. The public hostname, with an optional port and without a scheme or path, e.g. admin.podiumd.onsdorp.example. (PODIUMD_ADMIN_PUBLIC_HOSTNAME)

oidc.description: The Keycloak client of the Admin Tool.

issuer.description: Required. The https issuer URL of the Keycloak realm, without user, query or fragment, e.g. https://keycloak.onsdorp.example/realms/podiumd. http only for a loopback host (local development). (PODIUMD_ADMIN_OIDC_ISSUER)

clientId.description: Required. The Keycloak client id, e.g. podiumd-admin. (PODIUMD_ADMIN_OIDC_CLIENT_ID)

clientSecret.description: A reference to the existing Secret that holds the Keycloak client secret (PODIUMD_ADMIN_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET). The chart never creates it.

existingSecret.description: Required. The name of the existing Secret.

auth.description: How Keycloak roles map to the Viewer and Operator Roles (design D3).

roleClaim.description: The dot-separated token claim that holds the role names; empty uses resource_access.<settings.oidc.clientId>.roles. (PODIUMD_ADMIN_AUTH_ROLE_CLAIM)

roles.description: The role names that grant the Roles.

viewer.description: The role name that grants the Viewer Role. (PODIUMD_ADMIN_AUTH_ROLES_VIEWER)

operator.description: The role name that grants the Operator Role. (PODIUMD_ADMIN_AUTH_ROLES_OPERATOR)

database.description: The Admin Tool's own PostgreSQL database, with an app role and an owner role (design D4, D8).

app.description: A reference to the existing Secret that holds the database URL of the app role, used by the running Admin Tool Instance (PODIUMD_ADMIN_DATABASE_APP_URL). The chart never creates it.

existingSecret.description: Required. The name of the existing Secret.

owner.description: A reference to the existing Secret that holds the database URL of the owner role, used only by the migration Job (PODIUMD_ADMIN_DATABASE_OWNER_URL). The chart never creates it.

existingSecret.description: Required. The name of the existing Secret.

encryptionKeys.description: A reference to the existing Secret that holds the session encryption keys: comma-separated Fernet keys, the primary key first (PODIUMD_ADMIN_SESSION_ENCRYPTION_KEYS). The chart never creates it.

existingSecret.description: Required. The name of the existing Secret.

idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Minutes a session may be idle before it ends; at most maxLifetimeMinutes, which the chart checks at render time. (PODIUMD_ADMIN_SESSION_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MINUTES)

maxLifetimeMinutes.description: Minutes a session may last at most, 720 (12 hours) at most. (PODIUMD_ADMIN_SESSION_MAX_LIFETIME_MINUTES)

trustedProxies.description: Addresses or CIDR ranges of the proxies whose X-Forwarded-For header is trusted. Empty trusts no proxy; a /0 range is refused. (PODIUMD_ADMIN_TRUSTED_PROXIES)

items.description: An IPv4 or IPv6 address or CIDR range, e.g. 10.244.0.0/16.

extraEnvVars.description: Extra environment variables of the Admin Tool and migration containers, as Kubernetes EnvVar entries. A name starting with PODIUMD_ADMIN_ is refused: application settings belong in `settings`.

extraVolumes.description: Extra volumes of the Admin Tool pod and the migration Job, as Kubernetes Volume entries.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts of the Admin Tool and migration containers, as Kubernetes VolumeMount entries.

serviceAccount.description: The ServiceAccount of the Admin Tool pod.

create.description: Create the ServiceAccount; otherwise an existing one is used.

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Mount the ServiceAccount token into the Admin Tool pod.

name.description: The ServiceAccount name; empty uses the full name.

podSecurityContext.description: A Kubernetes PodSecurityContext. Never root (ADR 0007): runAsNonRoot is always true.

securityContext.description: A Kubernetes SecurityContext of the containers. The hardening fields cannot be weakened (ADR 0007).

capabilities.description: All capabilities are dropped and none are added (ADR 0007).

resources.description: Kubernetes ResourceRequirements of the Admin Tool and migration containers.

nodeSelector.description: Node labels the pods must match.

tolerations.description: Kubernetes Toleration entries of the pods.

affinity.description: A Kubernetes Affinity of the pods.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Kubernetes TopologySpreadConstraint entries of the Admin Tool pod.

livenessProbe.description: A Kubernetes Probe: the liveness probe (/healthz).

readinessProbe.description: A Kubernetes Probe: the readiness probe (/readyz).

minAvailable.description: The minimum available pods; empty leaves it out.

maxUnavailable.description: The maximum unavailable pods; empty leaves it out.

backoffLimit.description: Retries before the Job, and with it the install or upgrade, fails.

activeDeadlineSeconds.description: Seconds the Job may run at most.

ingress.description: An optional Ingress for settings.publicHostname, off by default.

className.description: The IngressClass; empty uses the cluster default.

tls.description: Kubernetes IngressTLS entries; an entry without hosts gets the public hostname.

httpRoute.description: An optional Gateway API HTTPRoute for settings.publicHostname, off by default.

parentRefs.description: Gateway API ParentReference entries. At least one when enabled.
